blockingIssues.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml concurrency group uses `${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}`; on push events this falls back to unique `github.run_id`, so stale runs on the same branch are not canceled.
DEVELOPING.md documents `typeCheckingMode = "basic"` and does not provide the requested strict-mode configuration guidance.
DEVELOPING.md includes a placeholder `...` in the new CLI command example, making at least one example non-runnable despite the expected runnable examples.
CHANGELOG.md v0.1.0 entry includes `### Added` but is missing required `### Changed` and `### Fixed` sections.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an orchestrator preflight rule that every feature `skillName` must exist in the runtime-available skill registry before worker assignment; if unavailable, route to a valid fallback skill and record the fallback.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All four reviewed public-ready features were assigned `skillName: cli-feature`, and multiple transcript skeletons explicitly show `Skill "cli-feature" not found` at runtime.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Split or extend the `cli-feature` procedure with a documentation-only path that does not require code-first/TDD steps when the feature scope is docs/config metadata.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three documentation-heavy features (readme-rewrite, developing-guide, community-docs) reported mismatch between docs-only scope and code-centric `cli-feature` procedure.

rejectedObservations.observation: Repeated reports that `cli-feature` was unavailable at runtime across individual feature reviews.
Repeated reports that `cli-feature` is a poor fit for documentation-only tasks.
